observations.why: Directive with operational cadence language ('from now on') performs a settled, load-bearing instruction the speaker expects others to follow.

evidence.quote:
A rollback
we have not rehearsed is a rollback we do not actually have.

observations.why: Aphoristic equivalence stated as bedrock — no hedging, no qualification; the speaker treats the rehearsed/unrehearsed distinction as constitutive of what a rollback even is.
Restates the settled cadence as an operational fact, not a proposal — the format itself (bolded label) ratifies the decision.
Assigning ownership is a performed ratification — the act of naming an owner settles accountability and expects others to operate accordingly.

mints.name: UnrehearsedEquivalence
mints.title: what we have not rehearsed we do not actually have
mints.frame: Is the conviction here asserting that an unpracticed capability is no capability at all — collapsing the gap between rehearsal and possession into an identity-level equivalence?
